name: windows-macos-round6-xhs-extension-ring-parity
title: Windows Round 6 Parity & Pitfalls Handoff (v1.1.0: Ring Gallery Viewport-Fill/Defaults, Xiaohongshu 3:4 Feed Card & Migration, Zero-Config Extension Bridge)
description: Comprehensive Windows handoff for all macOS features, wire protocols, UX foolproofing, and 7 real-world pitfalls landed between e8593f2 and v1.1.0: viewport-filling variable-width 3D Ring Gallery (defaults 1500px / 2px / 96% / 32px), full Xiaohongshu link/share-copy resolution with native 900x1440 feed cards (strict vertical 3:4 cover + bold title/author/likes footer) and idempotent startup cover migration, loopback-only local extension bridge (127.0.0.1:41937) with strict extension-origin zero-config auto-pairing (POST /api/v1/auth/local-pair), and shared Chrome/Edge/Arc/Safari extension X (2026 History/Bookmarks) & Xiaohongshu batch sync.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Issued alongside macOS v1.1.0 release so the Windows Tauri v2 + Rust Core implementation mirrors the exact Ring Gallery defaults, Xiaohongshu 3:4 feed card layout & migration, zero-config local extension auto-pair security contract, and shared browser extension fixes without re-hitting any pitfalls.
